fields.description: Master switch. Uncheck to disable ALL Procurement Policy enforcement (matrix classification + approval gate + GIT ageing cron) without deleting configuration.
fields.label: Enable Procurement Policy

fields.description: Comma-separated Item Group names that count as LPG (top-level or exact). Any PO whose lines all fall in one of these groups is classified as an LPG PO and uses the LPG matrix below; anything else uses the Non-LPG matrix.
fields.label: LPG Item Groups (comma-separated)

fields.description: PO grand total >= this NGN AND value ceiling of Tier 1: routes to Tier 2 (HoO + HoF). Leave 0 to DISABLE this tier.
fields.label: LPG Tier 2 Value Trigger (NGN)

fields.description: PO total qty in kg >= this AND volume ceiling of Tier 1: routes to Tier 2. Leave 0 to DISABLE volume-based routing.
fields.label: LPG Tier 2 Volume Trigger (kg)

fields.description: PO grand total > this NGN: routes to Tier 3 (HoO + HoF + COO). Leave 0 to DISABLE this tier -- Tier 2 becomes the ceiling.
fields.label: LPG Tier 3 Value Trigger (NGN)

fields.description: PO total qty in kg > this: routes to Tier 3. Leave 0 to DISABLE volume-based Tier 3 routing.
fields.label: LPG Tier 3 Volume Trigger (kg)

fields.description: PO grand total >= this NGN: routes to Tier 2 (CPL + HoF). Leave 0 to DISABLE this tier.
fields.label: Non-LPG Tier 2 Value Trigger (NGN)

fields.description: PO grand total > this NGN: routes to Tier 3 (CPL + HoF + COO). Leave 0 to DISABLE.
fields.label: Non-LPG Tier 3 Value Trigger (NGN)

fields.description: Hours a Draft Material Receipt Stock Entry from a GIT warehouse may sit before the ageing cron opens a review ToDo for the reviewer role below. Leave 0 to DISABLE the ageing cron.
fields.label: GIT Stale Threshold (Hours)
